verdict.rationale: Building and sharing custom assistants is a fair question for an AI agent product like Perplexity Computer, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only the MCP server, task execution, connectors, file handling and an analytics API. Nothing shows a way to create custom assistants with their own instructions or knowledge, or to share them.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can build and share custom assistants with their own instructions and knowledge
